scope: Read-only code review plus four targeted synthetic archive-policy tests; no Android/device operations, no repository edits, no full-source integration rerun.

findings.initialProblem: Derived analysis.json was eagerly decoded during artifact scanning. A killed final JSON write could reject the whole artifact and lose otherwise valid trace/comparison originals.
findings.resolution: analysis/* retained as original bytes; malformed or mismatching complete derived output becomes invalid with stable validationError and no reportedStatus. Source/context, path, size, source bytes, capture and comparison errors remain hard failures.

reviewedBoundaries: Run/repository/workflow/master/manual event/attempt metadata and source job/artifact timestamp association.
Required producer Python set is checked against Git, checkout and module resolution before validator import; verified original comparison source subset remains separate.
Canonical payload allowlist, per-file/aggregate JSON and binary limits, symlinks/nonregular evidence rejection and non-overwriting atomic archive destination.
Capture recorded, original comparison result and derived analysis validation remain independent; original failed arm cannot be promoted by successful capture.
Incomplete parent summary may lag original child only in explicitly unfinished capture stages, and mismatches are recorded rather than rewriting originals.
Missing/expired artifacts retain unverified denominators. Incomplete analysis files are preserved without validation; complete bad derived output remains invalid.
All scanned payload bytes are read again after validation and compared before publishing.
dependencyNote: The current archive validation path is covered by the 15 local Python producer entries. An additional lazy third_party_smoke_set_archive import exists only inside the unrelated legacy standalone CLI main; that branch is not called here.
limits: The four targeted tests deliberately stub host/parser semantics and are archive-policy tests, not Android or parser acceptance.
No claim of tracing completeness or reset caller causality follows from this code review.
